description: Search devices in the standard search/fetch connector format: up to 10 results as id, title and url; each id goes to fetch. Use when the client works only with the standard search and fetch pair (ChatGPT connectors and deep research). Do not use when search_devices is available: it adds filters, paging and structured fields. For identifiers use find_device_by_identifier. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

query.description: Search text, 2 to 200 characters: device name, type, model or manufacturer. e.g. "insulin pump"

name: search
title: Search devices (ChatGPT format)
